tagline: Spider patience. Eight runs, ten piles. The file is the tableau.
description:
One-suit Spider. Build descending runs king to ace. A finished run leaves the tableau. Deal a row from the stock when you are stuck — every pile must have a card first. Empty piles take any run.

Tap a face-up card to pick up the run from there. Tap a pile that will take it. Undo goes back one move. Close it and come back: the tableau is where you left it.

An unofficial port of spider-solitaire by lklynet. Same deal and the same moves; the React shell stays behind.
